curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Two kids now hold dominion over an ancient galactic tyrant, but how long can childish whims withstand incoming cosmic killers?
curatedMovie.description: After siblings Mimi and Luke accidentally awaken a ruthless alien overlord, they use a magical amulet to control him, drawing a wave of intergalactic assassins straight toward their quiet suburban neighborhood.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, wild, and funny, pairing campy sci-fi horror thrills with an accessible, energetic tone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Steven Kostanski blends creature horror with offbeat comedy, delivering a fast-paced collision of cosmic carnage and suburban mischief.
